CPU run field build points at its helper (NOT nonexistent source_build). Helper.source_build plus historical source_snapshot[*].snapshot are hash-bound; their mutable original GPU paths/oldbindings are never checked as current. No CPU rerun or native decode.
inputs.CPU_threads: Retained actual arguments -ompthreads:1 required and reported. This is not a timing/throughput comparison.
inputs.schema: Exactly case02_private26_col21_ExcessPorePress_NOT_wave26; original12-byte header [1000,26,769], then actualtime8+1000*26 doubles. identity: Exactly769 common indices/1000soil IDs40..1039, native_ids row0..999. Each backend physical initial XYZ must bitwise equal its own native x0; both initial x0 arrays bitwise identical, including signed0. Physical actual time bits must equal its own clock.bin; native locked dt exact, noninitial signed dterror finite/nonempty<=1e-14. Pair actualtime maxdiff<=1e-14 and paired completed-step schedules exact (half x2). No field removal/interpolation/time snap.

original_gates.definition_pressure: At every saved common time sqrt(mean1000((p_A-p_B)^2)).
original_gates.definition_u: For each actual soil ID u_A=x_A-x0_A,u_B=x_B-x0_B;1000*max1000 normXYZ(u_A-u_B). Cartesian component maxima also reported. Original native positions/material reference used; no interpolation/unwrap or full-cycle material tracking claim.

descriptive: All26 columns at all769 times have RMS/maxabs differences in field CSV, plus native velocityXYZ/effective-six-component-stress/J/theta/legacy passive rho/retainedLoadAce and J-derived n/V/rho/constantk differences in metrics. n0=float(0.3),v0=float(0.21)/2100,rhow1000; nativeVrhoK absent. k both fixed actual float1e-4, so its descriptive difference0 follows sealed model, not an observed extra native array. No arbitrary J/theta/stress/load/passive-rho/normal/category accuracy gates or all26-equivalence claim.
boundary: Pressure RMS in initial support-radius bands z0<2*float(0.018) and z0>1-2*float(0.018), descriptive only. No fixed field crosscomparison: CPUfixedn0marker versus GPUmirror sample remains backend-specific and already checked by each own reader.
ownership: Hash all directly sealed native exports/rawfiles/ownedcalls/programs. GPU current265 original/snapshot/doc/canonical7/runtime4 and helper110object closure are revalidated as current; CPU only immutable records/program/raw/snapshots as historical. Unique bound files cache initial hashing, all unique bound files rehashed after metrics. No solver/reader/helper/subprocess, no historical receipt overwrite; .readjson avoids variable shadowing. All output JSON scalars explicitly Python float/int/bool; no stdout/log parsing or UTF16 assumption.

output_names.sizes: Each metrics CSV769 rows; full-field CSV769*26=19994 rows. numpy memmap reads immutable physical/clock binaries, one1000x26 frame at a time; no large ledger CSV loop.
output_names.check: passed/physicalfalse/inputs:E[]/files:E[]/source_run:E (primary newGPU)/source_runs:E[]/source_build:E (primary newGPU) and native_checks:E[]. Suitable as a source-bound Root PriorGate CPUcross proof, not automatic half admission.

failure: All three new outputs must be absent. Missing/changed/unsafe inputs reject; numerical original-gate failure writes full metrics and passedfalse check with original limits, no fitting. Available partials retained on exceptions; no rerun/retry. Root must review source/note then separately execute and independently recompute/visualize.
scope: Only independent same-dt CPU/GPU implementation comparison and independentGPU half over.025s. CPUcross is NOT analytical theory validation. No public/formal/long-time/Cryer/generalwall/variablek/nonzero-g or physical acceptance, energy conservation, endpoint-force/face-flux proof. Native ledger/drainage/p0/safety already belong to hash-bound own reader; this pair does not claim independently observing all force stages.
